To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
phase-modulation of a SLED system is a feasible way to lower the peak field and, consequently, to lower the risk of breakdown.
the phase modulation of SLED drive power is a powerful technique to lower the peak field and that it is an efficient method to reduce the breakdown probability.
the SLED system of the FERMI@elettra linac has been operated in phase modulated operation mode.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the phase-modulation of SLED drive power.
the development of high gradient accelerating structures for the FEL application.
the study of the SLED operation mode in the phase modulated regime.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the FERMI@ELettra SLED system is a very powerful tool, which can be used to reach the expected performance.
the SLED operation at Elettra is feasible and that a significant increase of the gradient has been obtained.
, in order to reach the expected gradients, phase-modulation is mandatory and that, with phase modulation, the SLED system is a reliable tool for the FERMI@ Elettra project.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that phase-modulated SLED operation is a viable solution for the FERMI@ Elettra project.
we have successfully operated the FERMI@ELettra linac sections with the SLED system in the phase-modulation mode.
the phase-modulation technique is a very powerful tool for SLED operation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to achieve high peak field gradients without breakdown problems, by phase modulation of the SLED driver.
phase-modulation of a 1.5 GHz SLED system is a viable option to achieve gradients above 30 MV/m.
phase modulation can bring the SLED operation to higher gradient values with respect to the conventional SLED operation.
